data.name: The Light of Celestia
data.detailed_description:
The Light of Celestia is a story-driven action-adventure RPG set on the mystical island of Elaren. Step into the role of Zoe, a courageous young warrior chosen by fate to wield the ancient power of the Light Fragments-mystical relics that hold the key to saving her world from a spreading corruption.

Explore a visually stunning, hand-crafted world filled with forgotten ruins, enchanted forests, and celestial landmarks. Each environment is intricately designed to support immersive exploration and linear storytelling, drawing you deeper into a world where magic, myth, and destiny collide.

Uncover Zoe’s personal story as she struggles to overcome loss, awaken her inner strength, and reclaim the lost light of her people. Experience emotional narrative arcs and character-driven moments that bring depth and meaning to your quest.

Engage in fast-paced, third-person magical combat. Wield light-infused weapons to battle corrupted creatures and powerful foes. Master timing, movement, and combos to turn the tide of battle.

Traverse diverse, interconnected environments that support a guided yet exploratory gameplay experience. Discover hidden paths, solve ancient puzzles, and unlock secrets tied to the history of Elaren and the Light Fragments.

Level up and master your combat style as you gain experience through battles and exploration. unlock abilities to face the challenges ahead.

data.short_description: The Light of Celestia is a story-driven action-adventure featuring intense combat and mystical exploration. Step into the role of Zoe, a destined protector bound to ancient magic, as she unravels the secrets of Eldoria. Confront dark forces, uncover lost truths, and embrace the light within.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon RX 5500 XT
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-4770K / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • Storage: 14 GB available space
